title: 叠叠乐：十片分四组—测孔/柱—局部对齐套入—逐组计数
phases: Identify all ten pieces and map them to matching peg groups of counts 4,3,2,1; plan group order based on access and target orientation.
Pick one piece with an edge/body grasp leaving the matching hole(s) available.
On fresh RGB measure three non-collinear directed piece/peg frame features; dock aligns and seats onto the CURRENT group stack support, not the original board height.
Inspect actual seated support and increment only a visually supported group member; star or multi-hole parts need correct phase/polarity, not just center alignment.
Complete all ten pieces, release and home both empty arms.
failure_lesson: Four groups do not mean four pieces. Many completed releases remained off pegs; star orientation/seating and current stack height are specific failures in reference notes.
reference_success_scope: External native aggregate has successes; no all-ten success can be inferred from returned release flags.
